proposed_facts.reason: All five cited canonical excerpts were independently read. The entries write alternative destinations for distinct numeric states; Phys passes x18 as the helper's write-only zero-or-distance output. The strict threshold and movement scale match the helper, whose XY writes replace the preceding translation-derived velocity without writing self_vel.z. Animation exhaustion gates the exact-one selector, and canonical callee definitions establish outgoing states 0x16F and 0x172 beside the respective callback families. This corrects the accumulator claim and agrees with functionality.md without promoting rendered names or asserting callback-table registration.

contradictions.reason: Accept superseding the movement-accumulator fact: the helper never reads the prior output value and writes either zero or measured distance. Equality takes the distance/scaling branch.

Accept both rejected Laser Nail links: this unit performs transition positioning and dispatch rather than laser emission, and its non-one completion calls the 0x172 initializer beside BackPunch callbacks, not a FingerBeam entry. FingerBeamEnd is an incoming caller.

Accept deferral of all unresolved Laser Nail, Reverse Throw and Power Punch fact/link mappings listed above. Canonical evidence supports incoming post-beam transitions, positioning, exact-one dispatch and stored-victim preparation, but does not independently establish those player-facing equivalences. Preserve every non-one value as the alternate branch rather than reducing it to Boolean failure.
Accept deferral of debug/test intent. The IASA body establishes a human-slot guard, not a debug gate or development purpose.
Accept deferral of all three .sdata2 facts. Source zero/unit literals do not establish compiled pool size, encoding, placement or loads; no appropriate compiled evidence was supplied.

Accept motion-registration and lifetime deferrals. Keep 0x16D and 0x16E distinct and do not promote a unique entry name from rendering. The cross-file selector writes and victim handoff are visible, but unconditional preservation through engine state changes or human-input interruptions is not established by these excerpts.
